title: adr-authoring-skill Output
description: Output contract for a completed Architecture Decision Record

adr_id.description: Assigned ADR identifier, zero-padded three digits (e.g., ADR-003).

adr_filename.description: Full filename including ADR ID and kebab-case title (e.g., ADR-003-use-fastapi-for-ai-service.md).

status.description: Initial status. Must always be PROPOSED — Tech Lead changes to ACCEPTED or REJECTED after review.

prd_requirement_id.description: PRD requirement traced by this ADR.

decision_statement.description: The decision in one sentence, beginning with 'We will'.

adr_file_path.description: Relative path to the written ADR file (e.g., docs/adr/ADR-003-use-fastapi-for-ai-service.md).

architecture_decisions_entry.description: One-line entry to append to Architecture_Decisions.md. Format: 'ADR-NNN: [title] | Status: PROPOSED | Triggers gate: N'.

triggering_gate.description: Gate that remains blocked until this ADR is ACCEPTED.
